Name: ListStatusTable
Content:

]]>

Name: UnitPostInsert
Content:

insert into dmvtdv(line_nbr,ma_vt,ma_dvcs) select line_nbr,ma_vt,ma_dvcs from @$dmvtdv      
declare @e varchar(512)
select @e = ''
select @e = @e + dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(b.id) + '#' from dmvtdv a join dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs where ma_vt = @ma_vt order by b.id

update @@table set ds_dvcs = @e where ma_vt = @ma_vt

Name: UnitBeforeUpdate
Content:
if @@admin = 0 begin
  if @dmvtdv <> @dmvtdv_old begin
    if exists(select 1 from dmvtdv a where ma_vt = @ma_vt_old and not exists(select 1 from @$dmvtdv b where b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs) and not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights c where c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and c.user_id = @@userID and c.r_access = 1)) begin
      select 'dmvtdv' as field, case when @@language = 'v' then N'Tồn tại đơn vị trong các đơn vị bị xóa không hợp lệ, không thể lưu được.' else N'Some unit codes might not be removed or you are not authorized to execute this function.' end as message
      return
    end
    if exists(select 1 from @$dmvtdv a where not exists(select 1 from @$dmvtdv b where b.ma_vt = @ma_vt_old and b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs) and not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights c where c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and c.user_id = @@userID and c.r_access = 1)) begin
      select 'dmvtdv' as field, case when @@language = 'v' then N'Tồn tại đơn vị trong các đơn vị vừa cập nhật không hợp lệ, không thể lưu được.' else N'Some unit codes are invalid or you are not authorized to execute this function.' end as message
      return
    end
  end
end

if @ma_vt <> @ma_vt_old begin
  if @dmvtdv = @dmvtdv_old
    update dmvtdv set ma_vt = @ma_vt where ma_vt = @ma_vt_old
end

update @$dmvtdv set ma_vt = @ma_vt
if @dmvtdv <> @dmvtdv_old
  delete dmvtdv where ma_vt = @ma_vt_old
